query:
Let $3\leq n\leq rd+1$. Then, the composite
\[
\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n}^{\mathrm{far}}\subset \mathcal{H}_{r,g,n} \rightarrow \mathcal{H}_{r,g}
\]
induces a commutative diagram.
What is that commutative diagram?
response:
Picard groups:
  \[
  \begin{tikzcd}
  \operatorname{Pic}\big(\mathcal{H}_{r,g}\big) \ar[r, "p^*"] \ar[d, "="'] &
  \operatorname{Pic}\big(\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n}\big) \ar[d, "i^*"]\\
  \operatorname{Pic}\big(\mathcal{H}_{r,g}\big) \ar[r, "p_{\mathrm{far}}^*"'] &
  \operatorname{Pic}\big(\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n}^{\mathrm{far}}\big).
  \end{tikzcd}
  \]
Two-key-equation summary: the new free summand in \operatorname{Pic}(\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n}) is generated by the $n$ section divisors and $(r-2)\binom{n}{2}$ pair divisors, and the torsion relation $(2rd)\,\delta=0$ holds and is preserved by all pullbacks.
ground_truth:
\[
\begin{tikzcd}[row sep=normal, column sep=small]
\mathrm{Pic}(\mathcal{H}_{r,g})\arrow[rd]\arrow[rr,hookrightarrow] & & \mathrm{Pic}(\mathcal{H}^{\text{far}}_{r,g,n})\\
& \mathrm{Pic}(\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n})\arrow[ur]
\end{tikzcd}
\]
where the horizontal map is injective, and it is an isomorphism if $d$ is even.

query: If $d$ is odd, what is the the torsion component of \/ $\mathrm{Pic}(\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n})$?
response:
The torsion subgroup is cyclic generated by the class \(\delta\) and, when \(d\) is odd, has order \(2r\). Concretely,
\[
\mathrm{Tors}\big(\mathrm{Pic}(\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n})\big)\simeq \mathbb{Z}/(2r)\quad\text{(generated by }\delta\text{) when }d\text{ is odd.}
\]

FINAL RESULT:
Torsion component: \(\mathrm{Tors}(\mathrm{Pic}(\mathcal{H}_{r,g,n}))\cong\mathbb{Z}/(2r)\) generated by \(\delta\). Key equations used: the torsion relation \((2rd)\,\delta=0\) and the identification of \(\lambda\) as the infinite-order generator of the free part.
